steps: Real Chrome created an input map through fields, protected cancellation, preserved changes across three languages, reviewed and applied a source draft, saved it normally, and reopened the saved map for field editing.
The saved input map appeared in the assembly picker; reviewing and saving added the explicit v2 reference.
The saved assembly with input map planned and built through the real local Godot backend.
limitations: Chrome source web app on an isolated HTTP server; Tauri package and physical keyboard are not tested.
